info.desc: "Operation: Doomsday" is the debut studio album by British-American rapper MF Doom, released on 19 October 1999 through Fondle ’Em Records. It was his first solo release under the MF Doom name, following his earlier work as Zev Love X in the group KMD. The album was reissued in 2001 by Sub Verse Records with a slightly revised track listing. "Operation: Doomsday" is frequently cited as a significant release in the development of independent hip-hop, noted for its production style, use of samples, and the establishment of Doom’s masked supervillain persona. A deluxe remastered edition was released on 24 October .

podcast.body: Released in 1999, this album was revolutionary within underground hip hop in the United States. It featured MF Doom's fantastic lyrics delivered in a completely calm and reflective manner, which was not aggressive. The rhythmic bases used in the album incorporated experimental hip hop elements mixed with jazz, creating a highly praised sound. "Operation Dunsay es un disco revolucionario dentro del underground del hip hop y en Estados Unidos."
